summary: Delta IV is an expendable launch system in the Delta rocket family whose main components were originally designed by Boeing's Defense, Space & Security division for the Evolved Expendable Launch Vehicle (EELV) program. Vehicles are built at the United Launch Alliance (ULA) facility in Decatur, Alabama, with final assembly completed by ULA at the launch site. It comes in Medium and Heavy versions to cover a range of payload sizes and masses, and it launches EELV payloads for the United States Air Force as well as commercial satellites, though it is primarily a launcher for U.S. military payloads.
one_line: Delta IV is an expendable rocket in the Delta family, designed by Boeing for the EELV program and built by ULA, mainly for U.S. military payloads.
